title: Signum: Rome total war inspired 2d RTS
author: -pertinax-
selftext:
Long time web dev here who has dabbled in graphics and visual demos in the past. For the past few months I've been using my spare tokens left over from my main gig to work on my tribute to one of my favourite games of all time, Rome Total War.

What you see here is pixie.js as the game engine with react used for the game UI.

Sprites are built in blender and then rasterized and downsampled to get the low res pixel style I wanted. A few months ago, when models were less capable, I was painstakingly drawing the sprites with Aseprite but the results now look way better and take approximately 100x less time.

Music was generated with Gemini, and sound effects are a combination of some stuff from freesound.org and elevenlabs (which is very good).

On mobile the game can be installed as a PWA and feels somewhat native.

I'd say the main challenge is to tune the AI to give the gane a feeling of balance and overall to make it feel fun and draw you back for another go. I'm pretty happy with where it is right now but more work is still needed on the career mode balance and tuning. Just lots and lots of playtesting is needed for that.

If you are interested to try it is online at playsignum.xyz
